Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃：delete很，delete也
- 吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况：delete你的，redundant; 是很麻烦的情况
- 但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很不知道：不知道，The mental-state verb phrase does not take the degree adverb 很 when it is negated; use 不知道 here.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况：吃不安全的植物对身体有坏处，是一种很麻烦的情况，The original has two noun/predicate ideas without a linking verb. Add 是一种 to make the second part a complete description; remove 你的 because this is a general statement about people’s bodies.
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个人人，神农：有一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him clearly with a full noun phrase rather than using an unclear apposition.
4. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 但是：于是，The relation is sequence and result: people do not know which plants are edible, so a person wants to solve the problem. 于是 introduces this result; 但是 would require a contrast.

items.reason: 很 cannot modify the negated mental-state verb phrase 不知道 here.
The second predicate needs 是, and 你的 is inappropriate in this general statement.
神农 is first introduced here and should be presented with a clearer full noun phrase.
但是 can appropriately contrast the widespread problem with 神农 wanting to solve it, so changing it to 于是 is not required.
